programme.desc: S13 E06 — Devastation in Delta Township Murders are rare in tranquil Delta Township; so when a well-liked couple is gunned down in their home, residents are terrified until police discover the monster accidentally left a trail of breadcrumbs leading right to his door.
programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S08 E09 — Deadly Intersection The team digs into the 1983 murder of a dedicated mother of six, stabbed in an apparent carjacking; clues at the scene hint that a dangerous man from her past may be responsible.
programme.title: Cold Justice

programme.desc: S02 E02 — The Killing of Tristyn Bailey Thirteen-year-old Tristyn Bailey is stabbed 114 times by a classmate; her murder shocks the world as the case goes viral on TikTok.
programme.title: TikTok: Murder Gone Viral

programme.title: City Confidential

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Kimberly Saenz Suspicion builds as the DaVita dialysis center in Texas experiences a huge increase in code blues, with many patients succumbing to their injuries.
programme.title: Murder by Medic

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Rituals Of The Hidden Past In China, a burial site at Jiahu reveals a child's remains marked with peculiar modifications, raising questions about Chinese mortuary practices and more.
programme.title: Secrets In The Dark

programme.desc: Stubborn Poltergeist, Mile High UFO and More A man discovers he is not alone while livestreaming a video game; a shadow creature stalks a police officer on an empty plane; a UFO gets dangerously close to two commercial jets; a ghostly legend shows itself in England.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Blonde Desires (The Bruce Miller Story) Taking a look at the case of Sharee, who constantly lied to hide her spending sprees and raunchy online exchanges from her husband. The homemaker manipulated an ex-cop into believing she was being abused before a murder tore their lives apart.
programme.title: A Secret to Die For

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Leap Castle Shiver as paranormal investigators Corine, Leanne, and Kelly tap into the bloody history of one of Ireland's ghostliest spots; find out who, or what, is lurking in the shadows of this terrifying fortress, which could be a portal to the underworld.
programme.title: Destination Haunted

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Out of Place Learning how displaced artifacts spark fresh investigations and rewrite timelines; unearthing a forgotten tragedy in a remote mountain lake in India, checking out footprints that change human migration stories; reopening an ancient cold case.
programme.title: Buried Evidence

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Reign of Terror Revisit the crimes of Jack the Ripper as investigators try to ID his first victim; chase the Mad Gasser, who terrorized an Illinois town in 1944, then hunt for the Servant Girl Annihilator, a killer who stalked Austin, Texas, in the darkness.
programme.title: History Unsolved: The Investigation Files

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Disasters Examine mysterious holes in Israel; explore a ghost village hidden in the Colombian jungle, a shipwreck off the coast of Sri Lanka and a gutted airplane fuselage abandoned in Iceland.
programme.title: Mysteries From Above

programme.desc: S01 E14 — Where in the World Is Michael Jackson The Prince of Pop's incredible talent is matched only by his alleged salacious personal life.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: Superstitious Numbers Discovering why a whole country sees the number four as something to fear and why is thirteen so disturbing that there is never a thirteenth row on an airplane.
programme.title: World's Most Unexplained

programme.desc: S02 E09 — When Spirits Take Over A young woman is possessed by a demonic entity; a boutique falls under the spell of a spirit; and something evil tries to take over Kate Kirkpatrick's home.
programme.title: Paranormal Survivor

programme.desc: S01 E01 Sinister shapes hover over Chicago and Ruwa, Zimbabwe; an Australian is fighting for his life after taking a blast from a mysterious object; a UFO appears to taunt a U.S. military fighter jet over the Bermuda Triangle.
programme.title: Evidence of the Unexplained

programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Haunted Gift and More Ghost hunters spend the night with an evil spirit; playgrounds for the dead; colossal creature appears near the shore of an Irish lake.
programme.title: Paranormal Caught on Camera

programme.desc: Here begins as a hunt for a paranormal research facility in America's most haunted state turns into a journey filled with discoveries for a team of supernatural investigators.
programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Lost Colony of Roanoke Island Coastal erosion exposes skeletal remains; researchers discover a special type of spider; new evidence leads archaeologists to unravel the unsolved mystery of the lost Roanoke settlers; thousands of dead seals confound a wildlife enigma.
programme.title: Mysterious Islands

programme.desc: S01 E12 — Neulander: The Mysterious Death of Leslie Neulander Review the evidence when the accidental death of a doctor's wife, Leslie Neulander, doesn't add up; learn of local rumors that pushed the DA to re-examine photos of the incident; see why Leslie's husband, Bob, immediately became suspect number one.
programme.title: Murder by Medic
